[[File:FarlanderUniform.jpg|thumb|Keyan Farlander was awarded with several ribbons for his service in the Rebel Alliance.]]

'''Ribbons''', also known as '''tour ribbon''' were a type of award system issued to soldiers in various militaries at various instances in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Time/Legends|history]]. They represented a soldier's tour of duty during their service.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was awarded with these ribbons for each tour of duty he completed with the Rebel Alliance, which included his participation in halting [[Operation Strike Fear]], his actions during [[Operation Skyhook]], his role in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], his role in evacuating several Rebel transports and escorting them to Hoth, and his role in evacuating Hoth. The Rebel Alliance's tour ribbons always contained 12 ribbons per tour of duty completed, regardless of the actual amount of missions completed within one tour of duty. He kept his first three on his uniform, while the remaining two he kept in a [[medals case]].

By [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Chak Fel]] wore rows of medals that denoted specific campaigns and victories on his regal [[Empire of the Hand dress uniform|dress uniform]].<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
